summary: OpenAI announced that GPT-6 Astra is now available to Pro, Enterprise and Business Premium users in Work/Codex and via the API, with rollout to Plus and Business users planned next.

mechanisms.reason: Expanding access to more paid tiers and the API broadens the user base able to call the model, plausibly increasing aggregate token volume, though no usage figures are given.
mechanisms.quote: We will start rollout to Plus and Business users next.

practices.reason: A new model becoming available in the API is a concrete integration point engineering teams need to schedule access and testing for.
practices.quote: GPT-6 Astra is now available to all Pro, Enterprise, and Business Premium users in Work/Codex, and is available in the API.

notable_reason: This is the initial rollout announcement of GPT-6 Astra, OpenAI's next flagship model family, to production tiers and API access.
